body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; background: #f6f7f9; color: #1d1f23; } .top { background: #1d4ed8; color: white; padding: 1rem 2rem; } main { max-width: 640px; margin: 2rem auto; display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; } .card { background: white; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } form label { display: block; margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } form input { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem; box-sizing: border-box; } input:invalid { border: 2px solid #dc2626; background: #fef2f2; } .help-icon { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 1.2em; height: 1.2em; border-radius: 50%; background: #e5e7eb; font-size: 0.8em; cursor: help; } #task-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; } #task-list li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; } button { cursor: pointer; } const list = document.getElementById('task-list'); const form = document.getElementById('add-form'); list.addEventListener('click', (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('button.delete'); if (!button) return; button.closest('li').remove(); }); form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (!form.checkValidity()) return; const title = form.elements.title.value.trim(); const li = document.createElement('li'); const id = String(Date.now()); li.dataset.id = id; li.innerHTML = ` `; li.querySelector('span').textContent = title; list.append(li); form.reset(); });

content.text:
The form no longer shows errors when the page loads. Red styling and a short message under a field now appear only after the user has been in that field and left it, or has tried to submit. I checked the code by reading it, but I haven't run it in a browser. My syntax check (`node --check`) needed approval that wasn't given, so that didn't run either.

**What changed:**

- **`index.html`**: Each input now has an empty message line under it (`#title-error`, `#owner-email-error`, `#due-error`). Each input is linked to its message so screen readers announce it.
- **`style.css`**: The red style now only applies to fields marked as touched, not every invalid field. I also added a style for the message text and reserved a line of space for it, so the form doesn't jump when a message appears.
- **`app.js`**:
  - **When errors show:** a field is marked as touched when the user leaves it, and its message shows if the value is wrong. After that, the message updates as they type, so it disappears once the value is fixed.
  - **Messages:**
    - Title: "Please enter a title." or "Use at least 3 characters."
    - Owner email: "Please enter the owner's email." or "Enter an email like name@example.com."
    - Due date: "Please choose a due date." or "Please enter a valid date."
  - **On submit:** every field is marked as touched so all errors show at once, and the cursor moves to the first field with a problem. Nothing is added until the form is valid.
  - **After a task is added:** the form clears and the touched state resets, so the empty form doesn't show errors again.

**One addition you didn't ask for:** a title made only of spaces now counts as empty. The browser's own check would accept it, but the app trims spaces before saving, so it would otherwise add a blank task.

To check it, open `index.html`. The form should load clean. Click into Title and then out to see "Please enter a title.", or click "Add task" with everything empty to see all three messages.
